Annotation.String: This action unbinds the vPPB of a switch-attached connection with Unbind Option 2h, Simulate Surprise Hot-Remove.

This action shall send Unbind vPPB (5202h) for the vPPB of this connection with Unbind Option 2h, Simulate Surprise Hot-Remove (CXL r4.0 Table 7-36). It shall be offered only on a connection that is a vPPB binding of a switch. It takes no parameters.
cxl-fmd's properties of a memory domain of a host.
This type shall contain the cxl-fmd properties of a memory domain under /redfish/v1/Systems.
What the fabric manager knows of the host's use of this memory.
This property shall contain what the fabric manager has observed of what the host has accepted, mapped or put to use of this memory.
The fabric manager cannot observe it.

This value shall indicate that the fabric manager has no access through which to observe the host's use of the memory: the switch prohibits CXL.io access from the FM to a bound port or LD (CXL r4.0 Section 7.2.3.1).
cxl-fmd's properties of a connection.
This type shall contain the cxl-fmd properties of a connection.
Where the connection comes from.
This property shall contain where the connection comes from. It is advisory: nothing a switch reports says who made a binding.
A vPPB binding this run of the service made.
A vPPB binding the service found and did not make, or made before it was restarted.
A direct-attached connection of a head of a multi-headed device to the host its configuration names.
A direct-attached connection the service infers, with no evidence of a CXL.mem link.
cxl-fmd's properties of a CXL device.
This type shall contain the cxl-fmd properties of a PCIe device that is a CXL dynamic capacity device.
The sizes of CXLDevice/DynamicCapacity, in bytes.
This property shall contain, in bytes, the sizes Get DCD Info (5600h, CXL r4.0 Table 7-65) reports, which CXLDevice/DynamicCapacity gives in whole MiB.
The tags of the dynamic capacity of the device, from Dynamic Capacity List Tags (5608h).
This property shall contain the tag list the device reported in Dynamic Capacity List Tags (5608h, CXL r4.0 Table 7-78).
The sizes of a dynamic capacity device, in bytes.
This type shall contain the sizes Get DCD Info reports, in bytes.
The Total Dynamic Capacity of the device, in bytes.
This property shall contain the Total Dynamic Capacity field of Get DCD Info, in bytes.
The block sizes each region supports, in bytes.
This property shall contain one entry for each region the device reports, with every block size its Supported Block Size Mask has.
The block sizes a region supports.
This type shall contain the block sizes one region supports.
The region number.
This property shall contain the number of the dynamic capacity region.
The block sizes the region supports, in bytes.
This property shall contain 2 to the power n for each bit n set in the region's Supported Block Size Mask, in increasing order.
cxl-fmd's properties of a CXL logical device whose host has dynamic capacity.
This type shall contain the cxl-fmd properties of a CXL logical device whose host has dynamic capacity. It shall be absent until one of its properties is.
When the host's region table was last read to its end.

This property shall contain the time of the service at which the last read of the host's regions with Get Host DC Region Configuration (5601h), of which TotalSupportedExtents, AvailableExtents, TotalSupportedTags and AvailableTags are, completed with every page answered. A read that fails shall not change it. It shall be absent when no such read has completed. This is a property of cxl-fmd: CXL defines no such time.
When the host's extent list was last read to its end.

This property shall contain the time of the service at which the last read of the host's extents with Get DC Region Extent Lists (5603h) completed, every page with the same Extent List Generation Number. A read that fails shall not change it. It shall be absent when no such read has completed. This is a property of cxl-fmd: CXL defines no such time.
cxl-fmd's properties of a memory chunk.

This type shall contain the cxl-fmd properties of a memory chunk of a single logical device whose Set Partition Info (4101h), for its creation or its deletion, was sent without Immediate, and which is staged until the device is reset.
The partition the chunk waits for.

This property shall contain the partition of the device the chunk is staged for, which CXL r4.0 Table 8-311 says shall 'become active on the next reset (as specified in the command effects)'. It shall be present only while the chunk's Status.State is StandbyOffline for that reason.
A partition of a memory device that is to become active on a reset.
This type shall contain a partition of a memory device that Set Partition Info (4101h) staged, and the resets after which the device says it takes effect.
The volatile capacity of the device in all once the partition is active, in bytes.

This property shall contain, in bytes, the Volatile Capacity in all that the chunk was staged with, which Get Partition Info (4100h) reports as Next Volatile Capacity (CXL r4.0 Table 8-310) while the change is pending, less the size of any chunk staged before it and deleted since, or of any active chunk deleted since. A chunk being added shall become enabled once Active Volatile Capacity reaches it with no change pending. A chunk being removed shall be removed once no change is pending.
Whether the pending change removes the chunk.

This property shall indicate whether the chunk was active and deleted, its capacity staged to be taken off the volatile capacity at the device's next reset and active until then (true), or was created and is staged to be added (false).
The resets after which the device says a change of Set Partition Info takes effect.

This property shall contain the resets the Command Effect of Set Partition Info (4101h) in the device's Command Effects Log names (CXL r4.0 Table 8-254): ColdReset for Bit[0], and, when Bit[9] (CEL[11:10] Valid) is set, ConventionalReset for Bit[10] and CXLReset for Bit[11]. Whether one of them is enough, or all are needed, the table does not say. It shall be empty when the log lists 4101h with none of them, and absent when the log was not read, or does not list 4101h.
Configuration Change after Cold Reset.
This value shall indicate Command Effect Bit[0]: 'The change takes effect after a device cold reset' (CXL r4.0 Table 8-254).
Configuration Change after Conventional Reset.
This value shall indicate Command Effect Bit[10]: 'The change takes effect after a Conventional Reset' (CXL r4.0 Table 8-254).
Configuration Change after CXL Reset.
This value shall indicate Command Effect Bit[11]: 'The change takes effect after a CXL Reset' (CXL r4.0 Table 8-254).
cxl-fmd's properties of a dynamic capacity region.
This type shall contain, in bytes, the sizes and offset of a dynamic capacity region that the MemoryRegion properties give in whole MiB.
The Region Base of the region, in bytes.
This property shall contain the Region Base the host's Get Host DC Region Configuration (5601h) reports, in bytes.
The Region Length of the region, in bytes.
This property shall contain the Region Length that Get Host DC Region Configuration reports, the usable length of the region, in bytes.
The configured block size of the region, in bytes.
This property shall contain the Region Block Size that Get Host DC Region Configuration reports, in bytes.
When the host's region table was last read to its end.

This property shall contain the time of the service at which the last read of the host's regions with Get Host DC Region Configuration (5601h) completed with every page answered. A read that fails shall not change it. 5601h has no generation number, so the regions are what its pages said, not the table of one instant. It shall be absent when no such read has completed. This is a property of cxl-fmd: CXL defines no such time.
cxl-fmd's properties of a dynamic capacity extent.
This type shall contain, in bytes, the offset and size of a dynamic capacity extent that ExtentOffsetMiB and ExtentSizeMiB give in whole MiB.
The Starting DPA of the extent, in bytes.
This property shall contain the Starting DPA of the extent (CXL r4.0 Table 8-230).
The Length of the extent, in bytes.
This property shall contain the Length of the extent (CXL r4.0 Table 8-230).
When the extent list of the extent's host was last read to its end.

This property shall contain the time of the service at which the last read of the host's extents with Get DC Region Extent Lists (5603h) completed, every page with the same Extent List Generation Number. A read that fails shall not change it. It shall be absent when no such read has completed. This is a property of cxl-fmd: CXL defines no such time.
The tag list of a dynamic capacity device.
This type shall contain the tag list of a dynamic capacity device, as Dynamic Capacity List Tags (5608h) reports it.
Whether the tag list was read.
This property shall indicate whether the last read of the tag list completed. When it is false, the Tags property shall be absent.
The Generation Number of the tag list.
This property shall contain the Generation Number the device reported with the tag list.
When the tag list was last read to its end.

This property shall contain the time of the service at which the last read of the tag list with Dynamic Capacity List Tags (5608h) completed, every page with the same Generation Number. It shall be present while TagsKnown is false if such a read completed before, and absent when none has, or when the device answered Unsupported. This is a property of cxl-fmd: CXL defines no such time.
The tags.
This property shall contain one entry for each tag of the tag list.
One tag of a dynamic capacity device.
This type shall contain one entry of the tag list.
The tag, as a UUID.
This property shall contain the 16 bytes of the tag, in order, in the form of a UUID. An all-zero tag is the empty string.
Whether the fabric manager holds a reference on the tagged capacity.
This property shall contain Flags Bit[0], FM Holds Reference, of the tag's entry.
The LD-IDs whose host has accepted the tagged capacity.
This property shall contain the LD-ID of each bit set in the Reference Bitmap of the tag's entry. It shall be absent when the Validity Bitmap says the Reference Bitmap is not valid.
The LD-IDs to which the tagged capacity has been added with no host response yet.
This property shall contain the LD-ID of each bit set in the Pending Reference Bitmap of the tag's entry. It shall be absent when the Validity Bitmap says the Pending Reference Bitmap is not valid.
The extents with this tag.
This property shall contain an array of links to resources of type `MemoryExtent` that have this tag.
cxl-fmd's properties of a task.
This type shall contain the cxl-fmd properties of a task that follows a dynamic capacity add or release, or that the service made again from its operation journal after a restart.
The dynamic capacity request the task follows, and what has been seen of the host.

This property shall contain the request of Initiate Dynamic Capacity Add (5604h) or Initiate Dynamic Capacity Release (5605h) the task follows, as recorded before it was sent, the host's extents before it, and the extents seen added to or released from the host since.
Whether an operator has to decide what becomes of the task.

This property shall be present while a task that the service made again from its operation journal after a restart has not ended, and absent otherwise. The outcome of its command is not known: a read of the device ends the task when it shows the outcome, and a DELETE of the task monitor ends it.
The outcome of the task's command is not known, and the service holds what the command was to change until a read shows it or an operator ends the task.
A dynamic capacity add or release, and what has been seen of it.
This type shall contain a dynamic capacity request as sent, and what the service has seen of the host since in Get DC Region Extent Lists (5603h).
The Host ID the request was sent with.
This property shall contain the Host ID of the request (CXL r4.0 Tables 7-72 and 7-73).
The selection or removal policy of the request.
This property shall contain the policy of the request, as a value of CXLDynamicCapacityPolicies.
The region of an add.
This property shall contain the Region Number of an add. It shall be absent for a release.
The tag of the request, as a UUID.
This property shall contain the Tag of an add or a tag-based release, the empty string for an all-zero tag. It shall be absent for a prescriptive release.
The length the request asked for, in bytes.
This property shall contain the Length of a free or contiguous add, or of a tag-based release. It shall be absent otherwise.
Whether a release was forced.
This property shall contain the Forced Removal flag of a release. It shall be absent for an add.
Whether a release asked for the capacity to be sanitized.
This property shall contain the Sanitize on Release flag of a release. It shall be absent for an add.
The extents a prescriptive release named.
This property shall contain the Extent List of a prescriptive release. It shall be absent otherwise.
The Extent List Generation Number of the host's extents before the request.
This property shall contain the Extent List Generation Number of the read of the host's extents that BaselineExtents is.
The host's extents before the request was sent.
This property shall contain the host's extents as read before the request was sent.
The capacity of an add seen in the host's extents.
This property shall contain the parts of the host's extents with the tag of the add, in its region, that BaselineExtents did not have, as last read. It shall be absent for a release.
The capacity of a release seen gone from the host's extents.
This property shall contain the parts of what the release named that the host's extents no longer have, as last read. It shall be absent for an add.
A range of a host's dynamic capacity.
This type shall contain a range of a host's DPA space, with the tag of the extent it is of.
The DPA the range starts at, in the host's DPA space.
This property shall contain the DPA the range starts at.
The length of the range.
This property shall contain the length of the range.
The tag of the extent, as a UUID.
This property shall contain the tag of the extent the range is of, the empty string for an all-zero tag.
